{"consolidated_memory":"**Missing Step in Funnel Report: Five Separate Incidents in analytics/dashboards/funnel.py**

This recurring issue manifested FIVE SEPARATE TIMES in the same code location (analytics/dashboards/funnel.py, analytics side). Each occurrence had an identical symptom but different root cause and trigger condition. All five were resolved with targeted fixes. Common across all incidents: reproduction by building the funnel for a two-week window; signal of a stage with zero users appearing between two populated ones.

**Incident 1 [2026-04-07]**
- Trigger: jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- Root cause: a cache entry that was never invalidated on write
- Fix: invalidated the entry inside the write transaction (PR #3590 on branch fix/missing-step-2)
- Result: p99 latency fell from 3.6 s to 914 ms

**Incident 2 [2026-05-18]**
- Trigger: accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
- Root cause: a mutable default argument shared across calls
- Fix: made the default empty and built the value per call (PR #5015 on branch fix/missing-step-4)
- Result: the job finished in 82 minutes instead of 8 hours

**Incident 3 [2026-06-03]**
- Trigger: clients still pinned to the v1 SDK
- Root cause: a naive datetime compared against an aware one
- Fix: made every boundary timezone aware at the edge (PR #5776 on branch fix/missing-step-5)
- Result: the nightly rollup matched the source counts for 33 days running
- Test coverage: tests/analytics/test_funnel.py (Python stack)

**Incident 4 [2026-07-24]**
- Trigger: users sitting in a negative UTC offset
- Root cause: clock skew between the two hosts
- Fix: switched the deadline to a monotonic clock (PR #6781 on branch fix/missing-step-7)
- Result: the flaky test went from 94 failures per hundred runs to zero

**Incident 5 [2026-09-01]**
- Trigger: after a rolling restart of the fleet
- Root cause: schema drift between the migration and the model
- Fix: regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum (PR #7892 on branch fix/missing-step-8)
- Result: the alert stayed quiet for 92 consecutive days"}
